root_cause: The Studio listed many provider templates but could not independently choose arbitrary source/destination, describe direction, cadence, deduplication and conflict semantics; a schedule label could incorrectly imply running automatic ingestion.
prevention_rule: All new connector designs require versioned user-reviewed transfer policy, unique source+target registry entry, explicit direction and cadence, schema keys for incremental modes, privacy/use permission, and provider-specific runtime capability evidence. Never activate a reverse, two-way, webhook, CDC, backfill, delete, auto-schedule or unimplemented provider with only a template or sample test. Preserve existing original AFAS manual source reader and single tenant execution chain.

evidence.proof: GitHub Required and CodeQL + protected merge + exact Netlify deployment + browser
evidence.real_live_providers: AFAS READ_ONLY MANUAL only (tenant auth still required)

gates: Netlify exact SHA ready and native browser visible
real authenticated provider readback if claiming operational
original Heartbeat consumer ACK before claiming autonomous cadence
